trust_decision.summary: Two decisions: (1) which connector kwargs a URL string may set — create_connect_args forwards every URL query key (including file-path kwargs like token_file_path/private_key_file) to snowflake.connector.connect, and URL() interpolates account/region/user unescaped into the DSN so a field value can add query keys; (2) caller-supplied names/values in custom-command and table-option DDL are emitted without identifier quoting or literal escaping.

landing_point.why: The advisory's 'local file disclosure' (CWE-73) half points straight at the loop that copies URL query params into connector kwargs; the 'SQL injection' half leads to the COPY INTO / CREATE STAGE compilers in base.py.

fix_sites.entry_point: snowflake.sqlalchemy.URL(account=..., region=..., user=...) (alias of util._url, src/snowflake/sqlalchemy/__init__.py:93)
CreateStage(container, stage) DDL compile (used repr(container) as SQL)
fix_sites.module_kind: DDL compiler / repr used as serializer
custom command value object (__str__ as serializer)

fix_sites.entry_point: LiteralOption string value in CREATE TABLE options
AsQueryOption(select) compiled with default dialect instead of Snowflake dialect

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/snowflake/sqlalchemy/util.py:57-71 (URL() helper composes the DSN whose query create_connect_args later trusts); also src/snowflake/sqlalchemy/base.py:1107 (CreateStage used container __repr__, src/snowflake/sqlalchemy/custom_commands.py:535-541, as SQL serializer)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Once create_connect_args blocks the sensitive query keys, a solver can argue the URL() builder needs no account/region validation or user encoding because any injected keys are rejected downstream anyway; and repr() is 'debug only' per its docstring (src/snowflake/sqlalchemy/custom_commands.py:125-129) so CREATE STAGE looks like a logging concern.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Ordinary URL query params (warehouse, role, schema, account, authenticator=externalbrowser, timezone, cache_column_metadata/enable_decfloat) must still be forwarded; blocked params must still work via connect_args= and (fix) a legacy_url_params opt-in. On the DDL side, legal bare identifiers incl. upper-case and quoted_name(quote=False) idiom must stay unquoted, and SA's '__[SCHEMA_<key>]' schema-translate token must pass through quote_schema unchanged.

O6_input_shapes: sensitive kwarg supplied as a direct URL query key (create_engine string URL / SA URL.create(query=...))
sensitive kwarg smuggled through URL() account field containing ?/&/@/#
same via user field (percent-encoded rather than rejected)
quoted_name(..., quote=False) values that are structurally unsafe
str vs TextClause vs other types in ClusterByOption
single-quote and backslash in literals (Snowflake ESCAPE_STRING_LITERALS)

O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: host is an explicit override the caller is trusted to set; downstream blocklist rejects any query keys it smuggles
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: util.py, same function as the fixed account/region branches

O8_uncovered_routes.route: URL() extra-parameter loop appends dict keys to the query unencoded (values are quote_plus'd)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second query-param pre-processing path (e.g. a popped dialect-level param whose value is a file path or forwarded into connect kwargs) that bypasses the blocklist loop
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The dialect already pops cache_column_metadata/enable_decfloat/case_sensitive_identifiers from the query before the generic loop; a maintainer adding one more would naturally do it here.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: connect() merging extra kwargs (e.g. from an env/config source) into cparams after create_connect_args
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: connect() already rewrites cparams (application name); a config-file or env-driven default merge here is a plausible feature and would be a defaults/merge route past the check.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: create_snowflake_engine accepting connection params and re-serialising them into the URL query
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: This helper already rewrites base_url with urlsplit/urlunsplit; extending it to inject params is a natural convenience.

O9_family: CWE-73 external control of file path via connection-URL parameter injection, bundled with CWE-89 identifier/literal SQL injection in DDL compilers

O10_build.project_tests: Unit tests compile SQL/call create_connect_args without a server (fix adds tests/test_unit_connections_args.py, tests/test_table_option_quoting.py, tests/test_unit_escaping.py, tests/test_base_quoting.py); many existing tests in tests/test_core.py need a live Snowflake account and must be excluded.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add a denylist check for token_file_path/private_key_file in the create_connect_args loop and stop, leaving URL() field injection, host/protocol, and the DDL quoting sites untouched.
